messages.subject: argument is of length zero
parts:
Hi,

deploying my demo application using shinyapps is very exciting. I have found an error that I was hoping someone could help me.
My demo runs fine in my computer, but when I deploy it in the server, I'm getting this error:

Error: argument is of length zero 

My questions are:

1. Is there any way to query the console logs to pinpoint the problem?
2. I have the latest implementation of R, why the error doesn't show up when I run it locally?
3. Ultimately, how do I solve this?

Many thanks,

parts: I'm not sure whether it's possible to see the console logs on ShinyApps.io (Andy will have to answer that) but in my experience, the most common sources of errors at deployment time are 1) case sensitivity in filenames--case matters in Linux, but not on Windows, please check that any literal filenames in your R code match the exact filename on disk; and 2) encoding issues (though usually that doesn't result in "argument is of length zero").

parts:
I've found it!

Dear all,

thank you for your previous answers, I've found what the problem was and have solved it: in order to do that, I needed to see the logs of the shiny-server (AFAIK, not possible to see from the ShinnyApps interface). There, I found that the function stat_summary_hex() needs the 'hexbin' package that is not automatically instantiated. Including at the beginning of the script a line with:

library(hexbin)

solved the problem. (I needed to install that package, too)

I wonder why hexbin is not instantiated automatically, but just in case someone else run into the same problem, the approach mentioned above could help.


Cheers,
